name: Pharaoh's Daughter
title: The Woman Who Saved Moses
summary: Pharaoh's daughter found the little Moses in a basket among the reeds by the Nile. She took pity on the boy, adopted him as her own son, and named him Moses. Unknowingly, she allowed the child's own mother to nurse him.

keyEvents.title: Finding and Adopting Moses
keyEvents.description: Pharaoh's daughter found Moses in the reeds, had compassion on him, and raised him as her own son.
